usage:
```bash
npm ci
npm run dev     # local preview
npm run build   # static site in dist/
```
verified:
- **Build:** CI builds every page on every push and pull request, and deploys `main` to GitHub Pages.
- **Links:** the site address comes from `site.json` in [{{OWNER}}/.github](https://github.com/{{OWNER}}/.github), and CI fails on links to an old address.
